iflytek-text-proofread v1.0.0

- Initial release: Proofread and correct Chinese text, supporting 27 error types (typos, punctuation, word order, sensitive content, etc.).
- Handles up to 220,000 characters per request.
- Detects issues in official documents and general Chinese writing.
- CLI interface: Supports input via argument, file, or stdin, with optional raw JSON output.
- Uses only Python standard library, no external dependencies.
- Requires API credentials via environment variables.
